meta.title: What bike fits you, maker catalog
meta.timezone_note: Pages read on Oct 21, 2026, Pacific time.
meta.method: Each record comes from the maker product page, plus the maker store product data at products.json for colors or prices where noted. Pages were read with the gstack browse tool until it broke mid-run, then with plain HTTP fetches of the same maker URLs.
meta.null_rule: A field is null when the maker page did not say it.
meta.computed_values: Any computed number is marked, see weight_is_computed, the battery notes and the derived block.
meta.class_label_sticker: No maker page in this set mentioned a physical class label or sticker.
meta.not_legal_advice: This file records what makers say. It does not decide what is legal.

verification.timezone_note: Pages reopened on Oct 21, 2026, Pacific time.
verification.method: Every maker page was fetched again as static HTML. Shopify stores were also read through each product's own .js data on the maker domain, and Ride1Up through its page variant data. Each field was compared to the page text or that data by hand. Evidence quotes were also checked by script against the saved pages.
verification.browser_note: The gstack browse tool failed to launch during this check because its Playwright Chromium executable was missing, and no browser was installed. No page was rendered with scripts. The static HTML and product data held every field checked.
